title: AI model integrity or drift alert
steps: Preserve model manifest and drift aggregates
Distinguish benign shift from integrity compromise
Require signed retraining manifest before promotion
rollback: Restore exact before-state captured in the same transaction
notification: Persist in-app notification; no email, Slack or webhook send
evidence: Audit run ID, requester, approver, before-state, step results and timestamp
success_measure: Expected synthetic resource state is observed; this does not establish real containment
